recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If PHER later reinstates ImmunizationRecommendation or moves its content elsewhere, carry forward the FHIR-48726 wording under that separate decision rather than reopening the deleted core resource for this issue alone.
issue_request: FHIR-48726 was an Applied/Persuasive PHER R6 clarification asking to expand ImmunizationRecommendation Scope and Usage for completed vaccine series and long-lasting immunity, and to change ImmunizationRecommendation.authority wording from protocol to schedule.
initial_application: Commit ca679e2f10 applied the requested changes to source/immunizationrecommendation/immunizationrecommendation-introduction.xml and source/immunizationrecommendation/structuredefinition-ImmunizationRecommendation.xml while source/fhir.ini still registered immunizationrecommendation=ImmunizationRecommendation as an active resource.
additional_context: Later commit e073fb45ec removed ImmunizationRecommendation and ImmunizationEvaluation from source/fhir.ini and deleted the ImmunizationRecommendation source directory. The current active resource list includes Immunization but not ImmunizationRecommendation, so the authoritative files targeted by FHIR-48726 are no longer in current build scope. PHWG minutes confirm the 2025-01-02 vote, and no directly relevant Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reapplying the wording would require reintroducing or editing a resource that is no longer part of the current FHIR build; the correct current reconciliation is to audit that the request was applied before the later removal.

related_jiras.note: Reviewed in the same PHWG minutes as another immunization clarification, but it is a separate issue and was not needed to decide FHIR-48726.
